_comment: Ratchet-down baseline for scripts/verify_test_fidelity.py. This repo ships at strict fidelity for mapped core files (0 missing) against the pin in scripts/upstream_pin.json, so the baseline is empty. 'ts_parity' is derived from UPSTREAM_PARITY and checked against it on load. Scope: the MAPPING dict in scripts/verify_test_fidelity.py is the authoritative strict list of TS files checked (TARGET_MAPPING rows are only checked by --report-target). Default CI mode runs --strict via .github/workflows/lint.yml; this file is retained for local workflows that want to opt back into baseline mode (e.g. during an upstream sync where several ports land in flight). To baseline genuinely-divergent tests, run scripts/verify_test_fidelity.py --update-baseline after documenting the divergence in docs/UPSTREAM_SYNC.md.
